en: Sepia-toned vertical postcard showing part of an old plastered building with steep tiled roofs and simple rectangular windows, partly obscured by tall trees and vegetation. The lower portion shows a high, plain wall in shadow, while the upper part reveals gables and rooflines typical of Central or Northern European architecture. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
